description: This file defines the SectionItem class, which implements the Item interface and represents a section with a title in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It includes methods for accessing and modifying the title, equality checks, and string representation.

classes.name: SectionItem
classes.description: A class representing a section item with a title, implementing the Item interface.

methods.name: SectionItem
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SectionItem with a given title.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the section.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the section.

methods.name: isSection
methods.description: Indicates that this item is a section; always returns true.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the title.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on the title.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the SectionItem.
